C22 and C06 offer weaker parallels involving appointments, combined responsibilities, coordination, and comprehensive plans, but neither matches the child’s civil-defense-specific sequence and substance as closely.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"the great impetus you have given to our national civilian defense programs during the year that you have served as Administrator of federal Civil Defense","parent_excerpt":"I am deeply appreciative of your vigorous attempts to advance this program which has become one of the key elements in our efforts to prevent the outbreak of war.","explanation":"Both letters praise the recipient’s leadership in advancing the federal civil-defense program."},{"child_excerpt":"This closer association of civil defense with our other mobilization programs should assure more rapid progress in fulfilling our national mobilization objectives","parent_excerpt":"From now on I request that you also participate in Cabinet meetings to help ensure that the civil defense program is fully integrated into our national planning.","explanation":"Both describe integrating civil defense into broader federal planning and mobilization machinery."},{"child_excerpt":"the contribution you made to preparing the recommendations for civil defense legislation that I submitted to the Congress earlier this year, as also to the development of a comprehensive civil defense plan","parent_excerpt":"I will earnestly consider the findings of these Committees and suggest appropriate legislation in my annual message to the Congress next January. At that time I will also urge amendments to remedy the shortcomings in the existing civil defense statute.","explanation":"The child looks back on the legislative-recommendation process that C14 expressly initiated and requested."},{"child_excerpt":"the very satisfactory relationships you have established with officials of State and local governments across the Nation","parent_excerpt":"the Federal Government, despite its increased civil defense role, must remain in partnership with States, cities and towns","explanation":"Both make federal cooperation with State and local authorities a central component of effective civil defense."}]}
